data: yfinance daily OHLC auto_adjust=True (total return), 11 SPDR sectors + SPY
costs: 2bp/side ETF (4bp round trip) subtracted from every leg
methodology_notes: Entry = first trading day of each ISO week at daily OPEN (== 09:30 open == 09:30-10:30 1h bar open). Tuesday open if Monday holiday (conservative concrete choice, noted).
Ranking R = c[t-5]/c[t-25]-1 on closes strictly BEFORE entry day; window never touches most recent 5 sessions.
Exit = next week's first trading day OPEN (the rebalance IS the exit). Final open week dropped.
auto_adjust=True: returns are total-return (dividends credited to longs, debited to shorts).
Each leg = one trade (matches falsification's ~4 picks/week accounting).
